references.observation: Visitor report and photo sequence show the pavilion and connected covered galleries, and identify 13 bays flanking Yanshang Studio and 48 reproduction reliefs.
Photographs taken from the opposite bank show curved dark tiled roofs over the low galleries and peaked west pavilion.
Visitor photo shows the open three-bay Jade River Studio and its lower adjoining tiled galleries.
June 2009 vertical imagery shows the two roof alignments between the separate pavilion masses and adjacent terrace.
A walk through the exhibit shows timber-framed stone panels recessed into a white-and-gray wall, green square posts, red transom lattice and painted crossbeams.
The photographed open gallery has painted ceiling beams and a timber seat rail. The open gallery photo does not fix the east-bank roof alignment.

limitations: The covered passages on either side of Yanshang Studio and the west pavilion are included. The canopy hides much of the turn south to Chengxian Hall.
Aerial registration to two mapped roofs gives approximate dimensions and facing. Pavilion column count, roof curvature, and individual exhibit positions are estimates.
The panel shapes and restrained carved marks indicate the exhibit without reproducing the 48 historical compositions.
